'''Rumo Takashi''' was a member of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] stationed on [[Fremond III]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], he led Imperial forces during the [[Siege on Fremond III|siege]] of a fortified [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] warehouse complex.<ref name="GNN9" />
